text: Plain speaking is a cause of trouble, if the result of it is resentment, which is poison of friendship; but compliance is really the cause of much more trouble, because by indulging his faults it lets a friend plunge into headlong ruin.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
speaker: Laelius
reference: Treatises on Friendship and Old Age
location: Rome or his villa at Tusculum, Italy (presumed)
